\section{Exhaustive Visual Architectural Catalog}
\label{app:visual_catalog}

This appendix provides a dedicated, publication-grade architectural and mathematical diagram for every single one of the 230 registered modules within the NeuralOps ecosystem.
For each module, we present a standardized 3-panel academic breakdown consisting of: (a) the algorithmic data-flow and computational graph, (b) the structural matrix pattern (causal decay, sparsity structure, or low-rank factor state), and (c) theoretical complexity and parameter scaling against standard uncompressed baselines.
